chunks: Those among the people of the Book who disbelieve, and the idolaters, would not have been freed (from false beliefs) until the clear proof came to them --
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'al-Bayyinah' in Surah Al-Bayyinah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'al-Bayyinah' is often interpreted as the definitive proof of Imamate, particularly referring to Imam Ali (AS) and the Ahl al-Bayt, whose authority serves as the ultimate criterion for truth. This verse underscores the transition from the era of prophetic concealment to the era of clear guidance, emphasizing that true belief requires recognition of divine authority beyond mere textual adherence.
